initial_blocker.trigger: eunit:test({timeout, 0.01, fun() -> receive never -> ok end end}) returns process exit 0 without eunit_native_ok; reproduced without Cowlib
initial_blocker.cause: send_after/start_timer sleeping callback threads were absent from scheduler pending-work/deadlock detection
initial_blocker.fix: Register a pending-message-timer guard before spawning; release it after delivery and wake publication (also on unwinding). Include pending callbacks in timer liveness; receive timer cancellation is independent.

message_timer_regressions.before: Both minimal native tests fail on empty output, no compile failure. Both wait without receive-after, preventing a receive timer from masking the defect.
message_timer_regressions.after: Both minimal tests pass on native Nera and BEAM. start_timer checks its exact reference. Original EUnit fixture unchanged and completes.
message_timer_regressions.rust_unit: message_timers_remain_pending_until_callbacks_finish: multiple callbacks and receive cancellation/removal independence
message_timer_regressions.scope: Historical RED/GREEN evidence for callback liveness; unchanged fixtures also pass in the final full native suite.

receive_timer_handoffs.cause: Process WAITING publication can precede heap registration; pop_expired removes a timer before wake publication. Empty timer counters alone cannot establish deadlock in either phase.
receive_timer_handoffs.fix: The final production process-state termination predicate treats a published Receive wait with Some(deadline) as live until wake CAS publishes READY; no new sleeps or timing retries.
receive_timer_handoffs.determinism: Replay exact handoff states using production process transitions, timer insertion/extraction, termination process-state scan and wake CAS; local process table/counters; no sleeps, thread luck or global reactor/I/O activity.
